verdicts.reason: Neither candidate rearranges anything. Both drop the original single-row strip unchanged into the middle of a portrait canvas, leaving about 85% of it as empty dark space above and below. The headline stays strip-sized, so it lacks the presence a portrait layout needs, and the Shop button sits about 15px from the right edge. A also has lopsided side margins (logo about 38px in from the left, button about 15px from the right). B's margins are slightly more even (about 20px left, 15px right) but just as cramped against the edges, so it wins only on that minor point.
